title: The Undefeated
bio: The legend no one has beaten since the '80s. Calm as still water, and twice as deep. He remembers 1987. So does Lolo Carding.

player_low_cards: You're close. But close and finished are two different worlds.
I can see your ending. I saw it once before, with Carding.
Two cards, maybe three? That is how every failed legend begins.
self_low_cards: Just a few left. Like life, shorter than you notice.
Almost there. I have waited longer than you think.
Nearly done. The two of diamonds is mine. The crown.
self_winning_soon: It is over. I do not lose. Carding knows that.
One card. Thirty-seven years, down to a single card.
got_ipit: Hmm. Bold. Carding was like that once, too.
You blocked me. Good. There is no joy in easy.
One step. That is how the brave ones begin.
table_cleared: A clean table. A fresh start, my favorite moment.
Nothing left. This is the quiet before the storm.
Clean. In every cleaning, there is a lesson.
played_big_combo: Five. The number of years you made me wait, and then some.
A combo. Carding's last hand looked like this too, back in '87.
Five cards. Lovely. But lovely does not win.
